Text.Text: The ambush school is finished. You've earned your training honestly; keep it that way. You've finished my Last Word trials. I have no further work for you here.
Come back at rank 50 in Pistol. The canyon trials need a trained shooter, and I won't mistake confidence for training.

A crew in the canyon is selling my shooting discipline as an ambush school. Recover their tally so I can start shutting it down. Defeat six Last Word Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den. I'll give you the Anchorhead Canyon Range Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Last Word.

Here's the Anchorhead Canyon Range Key. Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Last Word Adepts, then return with the Last Word Canyon Range Tally.
A duel is an argument. Most men make their point loud and long. The last word is one shot, and it ends the argument. It isn't the fastest shot. It's the one that doesn't miss.

Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Last Word Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den.
Adepts. Young, fast, sloppy. They'll fan wide and talk to make you draw first. Don't. Six funerals, one conversation.
Defeat six Last Word Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den.
You've defeated six Last Word Adepts. Let me see the Last Word Canyon Range Tally.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have turned my old sightlines into ambush lanes. Bring back their calibrator. Defeat five Last Word Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den.
Your key still grants access to Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Defeat five Last Word Specialists to secure the Last Word Sightline Calibrator, then return to me.

I marshaled duels on that range for twenty years. When I hung it up, my best students didn't. They sell Last Word to anyone with credits and a grudge. Every graduate is a murder with my signature on it.
That calibrator zeroed the lanes for honest duels. In their hands it zeroes bushwhack angles. Bring it back and the canyon goes back to lying equally to everyone.
Specialists don't miss twice. They'll hold the long lanes and let the suns do half the work. Keep rock at your back and make your first shot the whole conversation.
Defeat five Last Word Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den.
You've defeated five Last Word Specialists. Let me see the Last Word Sightline Calibrator.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden is protecting the school's deep range. Defeat him and take back my crest. Defeat the Last Word Warden in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Shattered Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Last Word Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Last Word Shattered Range Crest.

Trained him. Vouched for him. He was patient when the rest were fast, and patience is the whole discipline. Then he learned patience collects better as a toll than a duty. He's still patient. That's the problem.
In Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Last Word Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Last Word Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Last Word Warden in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Shattered Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Last Word Warden. Let me see the Last Word Shattered Range Crest.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four running the school hold the marshal's challenge chit. Recover it so we can challenge the master. Defeat four members of the Last Word Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den.
Your key still grants access to Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Defeat four members of the Last Word Inner Circle to secure the Last Word Marshal's Challenge Chit, then return to me.

Two washed out of my classes, two never sat them. Between them they've graduated ten years of duelists who think a fast draw is a verdict. Killing the four won't undo that. It stops the printing press.

Old range law. Any shooter lays that chit on the marshal's table, the marshal answers. No seconds, no tolls, no terms. They keep it locked up because the man above doesn't take challenges anymore. We're going to renew the tradition.
Together, and from four directions. They fought as a circle long before they ran one. Whoever stood with you against the warden, bring them again. And watch the corners.

Defeat four members of the Last Word Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Last Word Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den.
You've defeated four members of the Last Word Inner Circle. Let me see the Last Word Marshal's Challenge Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master has answered the challenge. Defeat him in the Canyon Dueling Pit to finish the Last Word trials. Defeat the Last Word Master in Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit. Report back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Last Word Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

My last student. I gave him the discipline whole because he was the only one who could hold it. He held it, then he sold it. Every grave that school dug traces back to a lesson I taught. This argument was always half mine.
In Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Last Word Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Like the argument ended before you drew, and everything after is paperwork. He'll spend the first exchange reading you, and most don't survive the reading. Three of you is three stories at once. That's your opening. It's the only one.

Defeat the Last Word Master in Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit. Report back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Smuggler's Den; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Last Word Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The ambush school is finished. You've earned your training honestly; keep it that way. You've earned the right to train Last Word. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the adepts.
I'll defeat six Last Word Adepts.
What is the Last Word?
How do I get in?
What am I walking into?
Not today.
Here's the Last Word Canyon Range Tally.
Back to the specialists.
I'll defeat five Last Word Specialists.
Who are these people?
Why does the calibrator matter?
How do specialists fight?
Give me a day.
Here's the Last Word Sightline Calibrator.
Back to the warden.
I'll defeat the Last Word Warden.
You trained him?
Where does he hold?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Not until I'm ready.
Here's the Last Word Shattered Range Crest.
Back to the circle.
I'll defeat four members of the Last Word Inner Circle.
Who are the four?
What does the chit actually do?
How will they come at me?
Not yet.
Here's the Last Word Marshal's Challenge Chit.
Back to the master.
I'll face the Last Word Master and report back.
Who is he to you?
Where does he wait?
How does a man who never lost fight?
Not yet. Not for this.
The Last Word Master is defeated. Here's my report.
